brief:
The war has cost the Israeli treasury 420 billion shekels, according to Maan Wire. The figure reflects direct expenditures since the conflict's outbreak, encompassing military operations, security measures, and related state expenses across multiple government agencies and defense ministries.

The 420-billion-shekel total represents spending across defense budgets, emergency appropriations, and operational costs tied to the extended conflict. Government finances have absorbed the costs through both regular budget allocations and supplementary funding measures approved by parliament to sustain military and security operations.
title: Israel's war spending reaches 420 billion shekels
